kinetograph.title: Kinetic typography
kinetograph.description: Captions timed to the voice in fifteen ready-made styles: a big word set huge in a hook, highlighter, typewriter, text selection, shine, prism (difference) and more, each word moving in and out with bounce, flicker, shake and steps and an accent and a readable shadow taken from the footage. Also hand-written captions hung off a tracked subject.
